title: Daily digest: Hundreds demand removal of Gyanesh Kumar | IMD forecasts intense rain in Telangana  | Cabinet will discuss proposal on establi | Alliance gave them a stomach ache: Akhil
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Telangana Today / India Today
bullets_en: Hundreds demand removal of Gyanesh Kumar in anti-SIR protest in Hyderabad.
IMD forecasts intense rain in Telangana from October 27.
Cabinet will discuss proposal on establishing Buddhist university: Chief Minister.
Alliance gave them a stomach ache: Akhilesh Yadav tears into BJP over 'fake' posters.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad mein anti-SIR ehtijaj ke dauran sainkon logon ka Gyanesh Kumar ko hatane ka mutalba.
IMD ne 27 October se Telangana mein shadeed baarish ki paishgoi kar di.
Buddhist university ke qiyam ki tajweez par cabinet mein ghaoor hoga: Wazir-e-Ala
Alliance ne unka pait kharab kar diya: Akhilesh Yadav ka BJP par 'jaali' posters ko le kar hamla.
